trust_decision.summary: filter-branch --index-filter must not materialize untrusted history trees onto the filesystem; at the pin _apply_index_filter checks every tree out into CWD via build_index_from_tree, so a symlink left there by an ancestor commit redirects a descendant commit's writes outside the tree (build_index_from_tree checks path elements but never checks for symlinked parent dirs).

landing_point.why: the summary names filter-branch index_filter, and CommitFilter._apply_index_filter is the only index_filter implementation

fix_sites.entry_point: new public helper dulwich.index.index_entry_from_tree_entry (support only, not a security check)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: the fix changes no site in another module; index.py only gains a helper (fix.diff:95-126)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: For the O8 CLI tree-filter route: the advisory is about index_filter and cross-commit state, while the tree filter gets a fresh TemporaryDirectory per tree (dulwich/filter_branch.py:179), so a solver can say the 'persistence' precondition is absent and leave it.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: index-filter must still see the full tree in the temp index, including symlink-mode entries and gitlinks, and an identity filter must give back the same tree; a fix that drops or rejects symlink entries, or refuses trees that contain symlinks, changes rewritten history

O6_input_shapes: ancestor commit with a symlink at path P, then a descendant with a directory at P holding regular files (cross-commit)
regular and symlink blobs (size from raw_length)

O7_producer.where: the persisted state is plain on-disk files in CWD left by dulwich/index.py:2194-2218; no schema, serializer or cache is involved

O8_uncovered_routes.route: CLI --tree-filter exports tree entries to tmpdir by joining the raw entry name with no path-element validation (parse_tree does not reject '/' or '..'), and writes blobs with write_bytes
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: a different filter (tree, not index), in the CLI layer rather than filter_branch.py, with a fresh temp dir per tree, so there is no cross-commit persistence
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: another file (dulwich/cli.py, ~6.3k lines in) from the landing point in dulwich/filter_branch.py

O8b_injection_room.sibling: make _apply_tree_filter check the tree out with build_index_from_tree into a temp dir reused across commits (the comment 'We need a proper checkout implementation here' invites exactly this)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the existing TODO asks a maintainer to add a checkout here, and reusing the same helper and a persistent dir is the obvious implementation

O8b_injection_room.sibling: sparse-checkout disable materializes the HEAD tree into an existing worktree via build_index_from_tree, which has no symlinked-parent check
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: same helper, applied to a directory that already holds state; a maintainer reaching for 'full checkout' would call it

O9_family: CWE-22/CWE-59 path traversal via a symlinked parent directory during tree materialization (link following)

O10_build.toolchain: Python 3 + pip install -e . (optional Rust extensions, pure-Python fallback)
O10_build.project_tests: tests/test_filter_branch.py (CommitFilterTests), tests/cli/test_cli.py:1550 test_filter_branch_index_filter, tests/porcelain filter_branch tests

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: clean CWD between commits, or add a symlinked-parent lstat check to build_index_from_tree, but keep writing into '.' (still clobbers the caller's CWD) instead of building the index in memory

out_of_scope_notes: build_index_from_tree (dulwich/index.py:2149) itself never checks for symlinked parent dirs; it is documented as 'Suitable only for fresh clones' (dulwich/index.py:2179-2180) and is also used by worktree reset (dulwich/worktree.py:841) and submodule init (dulwich/porcelain/submodule.py:254).
